## Match metadata to raw data
```{r}

#match the metadata to the concentration data 
alldat$metadat_row <- ffi_metadata_match(
  data_timestamps = alldat$TIMESTAMP,
  start_dates = metadat$Date,
  start_times = metadat$Time_start,
  obs_lengths = metadat$Obs_length) 
head(alldat)

#Set plot, temp, volume, etc. here 
alldat$Plot <- metadat$Plot[alldat$metadat_row]
alldat$ID <- metadat$Plot1[alldat$metadat_row]
alldat$Volume <- metadat$Volume[alldat$metadat_row]
alldat$Hand_Temp <- metadat$Temp_ByHand[alldat$metadat_row] #found online from weather 
alldat$Site <- metadat$Site[alldat$metadat_row]
metadat$metadat_row <- seq_len(nrow(metadat))

#We need one more line that creates a column for final temp and takes the L1 data but if there isn't L1 data it will pull in another datatype 
# in this case we will use the by hand data i guess? but we could look to using some sort of NOAA dataset.... that we would need to match 

alldat$final_temp <- as.numeric(alldat$Hand_Temp)

# View rows in alldat with no metadata match
matched <- alldat %>% 
  select(metadat_row) %>% 
  distinct() 

unmatched <- metadat %>%
  anti_join(matched, by = "metadat_row")

head(unmatched)
```

## Calculate fluxes 
```{r}
#change the units
alldat$CH4_nmol <- ffi_ppb_to_nmol(alldat$CH4, 
                                volume = alldat$Volume, # m3
                                temp = alldat$final_temp)    # degrees C
#> Assuming atm = 101325 Pa
#> Using R = 8.31446261815324 m3 Pa K-1 mol-1

alldat$CH4_nmol_m2 <- alldat$CH4_nmol / 0.16

fluxes <- ffi_compute_fluxes(alldat,
                             group_column = "Plot", 
                             time_column = "TIMESTAMP", 
                             gas_column = "CH4_nmol_m2", 
                             dead_band = 10) #, c0_band = 5? 
head(fluxes)

#take a look at the fluxes we calculated with R2 
ggplot(fluxes, aes(Plot, lin_flux.estimate, color = lin_r.squared)) +
  geom_point(size=4) + theme_classic() + 
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lin_flux.estimate- lin_flux.std.error,
                   ymax = lin_flux.estimate+ lin_flux.std.error)) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colours = c("darkred",  "red", "white","lightblue", "darkblue"),
                        values = c(0, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 1)) +
  ylab("CH4 flux (nmol/m2/s)")

#sort fluxes by R2 
fluxes_good <- as.data.frame(subset(fluxes, lin_r.squared >= .90, select = Plot:TIMESTAMP_max))
fluxes_weird <- as.data.frame(subset(fluxes, lin_r.squared < .90, select = Plot:TIMESTAMP_max))

#find fluxes that represent the first and fourth quartile of the data 
low <- quantile(fluxes$lin_flux.estimate, 0.05) 
high <- quantile(fluxes$lin_flux.estimate, 0.95) 

fluxes_low <- as.data.frame(subset(fluxes, lin_flux.estimate <= low, select = Plot:TIMESTAMP_max))
fluxes_high <- as.data.frame(subset(fluxes, lin_flux.estimate >= high, select = Plot:TIMESTAMP_max))

tails <- rbind(fluxes_low, fluxes_high)

```

## Check the fluxes for which I changed the start time due to lags or ebullition (recorded in notes of metadata)
```{r}

tobechecked <- c()

colnames <- c("Plot")

#Loop to run plots above 
for(P in tobechecked){ 
  r1 <- subset(alldat, Plot == P)
  p1 <- ggplot(r1, aes(TIMESTAMP, CH4)) + geom_point() + theme_classic() +
  ylab(expression(paste( CH [4], " (ppb)"))) +
  xlab("Time") + labs(title = P) + 
  geom_smooth()
  print(p1)
  }

#list of the ones that I changed and checked and looked good? 
fixedplots <- c()
  

```


## Spot check a few fluxes with R2 > 0.9
```{r, echo=FALSE}

# take a random sample (FALSE so we don't get the same plot twice)

good_sample <- sample(good_plots, 5, replace=FALSE)

#Loop to run five random plots subset above 
for(P in good_sample){ 
  r1 <- subset(alldat, Plot == P)
  p1 <- ggplot(r1, aes(TIMESTAMP, CH4)) + geom_point() + theme_classic() +
  ylab(expression(paste( CH [4], " (ppb)"))) +
  xlab("Time") + labs(title = P) + 
  geom_smooth()
  print(p1)
  }


```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
#Notes on the bad ones 

##Fluxes to change: 
#GWI_TR_3_202607 - change start time to 10:10
#GWI_W_4_202607 - 12:42 to 12:44
#MSM_TR_3_202607 - change start time to 13:07
#SWH_TR_1_202607 - huge jump in the middle, clip at 12:25
#SWH_TR_2_202611 - start flux at 13:16
#SWH_TR_3_202607 - end at 10:57

##Fluxes to remove (high CH4 or ebullition)
#GWI_W_1_202607 - looks like stairs, several large decreases with slow decrease afterwards
#GWI_W_2_202607 - sinusoidal shape
#GWI_W_3_202607 - potential ebullition at the beginning
#MSM_TR_2_202607 - ebullition in the middle of the flux
#SWH_TR_4_202609 - very messy
#SWH_TR_4_202611 - looks like stairs, several large increases with slow increase afterwards

##Added notes to metadata for the ones I fixed

####Add qaqc flags####

fluxes$qaqc_flag <- NA

##Fluxes with crazy high CH4 values
high_CH4_flags <- c()

fluxes <- fluxes %>%
    mutate(qaqc_flag = ifelse(is.na(qaqc_flag) & Plot %in% high_CH4_flags, "Unusually high CH4 values, remove", qaqc_flag))

#Fluxes that need to be removed
remove_flags <- c("GWI_W_1_202607", "GWI_W_2_202607", "GWI_W_3_202607", "MSM_TR_2_202607", "SWH_TR_4_202609", "SWH_TR_4_202611")

fluxes <- fluxes %>%
    mutate(qaqc_flag = ifelse(is.na(qaqc_flag) & Plot %in% remove_flags, "messy flux, remove", qaqc_flag))

#Any other fluxes that had low R squared but are okay otherwise
fluxes <- fluxes %>%
    mutate(qaqc_flag = ifelse(is.na(qaqc_flag) & Plot %in% bad_plots, "low r squared, but checked and flux is okay", qaqc_flag))
```

## Do some visualization of QAQC plots to assess fluxes  
```{r, echo=FALSE}

p1 <- ggplot(fluxes, aes(lin_flux.estimate, rob_flux.estimate, color = Plot)) +
  geom_point(size=4) + geom_abline() + 
  theme_classic() + 
  labs(title = "A") + 
  ylab(expression(paste( CH [4], " Flux (nmol m"^-2* " s"^-1*") Robust Method"))) +
  xlab(expression(paste( CH [4], " Flux (nmol m"^-2* " s"^-1*") Linear Method"))) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Plot")) +
  theme(legend.position="none") +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size=12), axis.text = element_text(size=12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=12), legend.text=element_text(size=12),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth =1), 
        aspect.ratio = 1)
p1


p2 <- ggplot(fluxes, aes(lin_r.squared, poly_r.squared, color = Plot)) +
  geom_point(size=4) + geom_abline() + 
  theme_classic() + 
  xlim(0,1) + ylim(0,1) +
  labs(title = "B") + 
  ylab(expression(paste("R"^2* " Second-Order Polynomial"))) +
  xlab(expression(paste("R"^2* " Linear Model"))) +

p2
```

## Pull together dataframe and export for use elsewhere 
```{r, echo=FALSE}

#head(fluxes1)

#make new columns with the plot; zone; replicate 
IDs <- data.frame(do.call('rbind', strsplit(as.character(fluxes$Plot),'_',fixed=TRUE)))
colnames(IDs) <- c("Site",  "Zone", "Replicate", "Date") 
head(IDs)

#rejoin them to the dataframe
allflux <- cbind(IDs, fluxes)

##Add in notes from metadata
metadat_notes <- metadat[, c("Plot", "Temp_ByHand", "Notes", "tz_Licor")]
allflux_notes <- allflux %>% 
  left_join(metadat_notes, by=c("Plot"="Plot"))

#export as a csv to the folder that you want 
write.csv(allflux_notes, file="Processed Data/COMPASS_Synoptic_CB_Macrophyte_Fluxes_Final_2026_CH4.csv")           #Change file name


```

##Histogram of CH4 concentrations by Site
```{r}

alldat_plot <- subset(alldat, !is.na(Site))

hist <- ggplot(alldat_plot, aes(x = CH4)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, color = "black", fill = "skyblue", na.rm = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ Site, scales = "free") + # Creates separate plots for each group
  labs(title = "Methane spans by site for 2026", x = "CH4 Conc (ppb)", y = "Frequency")+ 
  theme_classic()
hist

ggsave("CH4_span.png", 
       plot = hist, 
       width = 8,
       height = 4,
       units = "in",
       dpi = 300)

##Do the same thing but average CH4 per flux measurement taken
#ensure there is only one data observation per flux measurement 
alldat_plot_means <- alldat_plot %>% 
    group_by(Plot, Site) %>%
    summarize(CH4_avg = mean(CH4)) 


hist_avgs <- ggplot(alldat_plot_means, aes(x = CH4_avg)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, color = "black", fill = "skyblue", na.rm = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ Site, scales = "free") + # Creates separate plots for each group
  labs(title = "Avg methane per flux measurement by site for 2026", x = "CH4 Conc (ppb)", y = "Frequency")+ 
  theme_classic()
hist_avgs

ggsave("CH4_span_avgs.png", 
       plot = hist_avgs, 
       width = 8,
       height = 4,
       units = "in",
       dpi = 300)

```
